name: Pixel-flip
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Progressively perturbs image pixels in decreasing attribution order. Computation: Perturbation curve.
review_studies: Szandałla 2021; Hryniewska-Guzik et al. 2024; Thomas et al. 2023

name: Concept Flipping / Concept Insertion
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Concept-level analogue of pixel-flip: concepts are progressively removed or inserted according to their importance. Computation: Perturbation curve.

name: Deletion / Insertion
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Important pixels are progressively removed (Deletion) or added (Insertion); faithfulness read from the area under the prediction curve. Computation: AUC.
review_studies: Englebert et al. 2024; Englebert et al. 2022; Xie et al. 2022; Mehri et al. 2024; Nielsen et al. 2023; Sammani et al. 2023; Liu et al. 2024; Herdt et al. 2024; Li et al. 2022a; Li et al. 2023c; Cheng et al. 2022; Qi et al. 2020; Novello et al. 2022; Zhang et al. 2025; Li et al. 2023a; Yoldar et al. 2025; Hong et al. 2025; Wu et al. 2024a; Mehri et al. 2025; Fu et al. 2021

name: Ascending-order Deletion (Wu et al. 2024a)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Deletion variant where pixels are removed in ascending order of importance. Computation: AUC.

name: RD / RI
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Robust Deletion/Insertion variants that compute expected metric scores over perturbed image neighborhoods. Computation: Expected value & AUC.

name: EvalAttAI
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Continuous perturbation scheme where the image is iteratively modified using the attribution map itself. Computation: AUC.

name: Deletion for object detection (Petsiuk et al. 2021)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: The Deletion metric extended to the object-detection task. Computation: AUC.
review_studies: Carion et al. 2020; Andres et al. 2024; Chen et al. 2025

name: Superpixel Deletion/Insertion (Yoshikawa et al. 2024)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Deletion/Insertion extended to superpixels. Computation: AUC.

name: Effect Score
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Deletion/Insertion-based score that penalizes large superpixel explanations. Computation: Weighted mix of Deletion & Insertion.
tags: I.A.1; Weighted mix of Deletion & Insertion

name: Concept-level Deletion/Insertion (Hasić 2025)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Deletion/Insertion extended to concept-level explanations. Computation: AUC.

name: SDC / SSC
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Identifies the minimal set of concepts that destroys (SDC) or sustains (SSC) a prediction. Computation: Minimum number of concepts satisfying a condition.
tags: I.A.1; Minimum number of concepts satisfying a condition
review_studies: Vielhaben et al. 2023; Grobrügge et al. 2025; Fel et al. 2023

name: AOPC
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Measures cumulative prediction change along MoRF/LeRF perturbation curves. Computation: AOPC.
review_studies: Saifullah et al. 2024; Agne et al. 2024; Lei et al. 2023; Binder et al. 2023

name: ABPC
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Measures the area between the MoRF and LeRF perturbation curves. Computation: AOPC.

name: Comprehensiveness / Sufficiency
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Measures cumulative prediction change when removing or retaining the top-ranked regions. Computation: AOPC.

name: ROAR
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: AOPC variant that retrains the model on explanation-guided modified images to address the OOD issue. Computation: AOPC.

name: ROAD
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: AOPC variant employing Noisy Linear Imputation (NLI) perturbations to mitigate class information leakage. Computation: AOPC.
review_studies: Vukadin et al. 2024b; Hong et al. 2025

name: IROF
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: AOPC variant employing a segmentation algorithm to partition images into regions. Computation: AOPC.
review_studies: Vukadin et al. 2024b; Demetriou et al. 2025; Tanis et al. 2025; Ahmad et al. 2024; Klotz et al. 2025

name: SaCo
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Pairwise region comparison that evaluates whether higher-saliency regions cause larger confidence drops. Computation: Normalized aggregation of salience score differences.
tags: I.A.1; Normalized aggregation of salience score differences

name: AD / IC
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Compares predictions on the original image and the explanation mask: AD = confidence drop (floored at zero), IC = whether the explanation map increases prediction confidence. Computation: Confidence score comparison.
review_studies: Ibrahim and Shafiq 2022; Lee et al. 2021; Qiu et al. 2024; Zheng and Li 2024; Li et al. 2023c; Oh et al. 2021; Davydko et al. 2024; Iqbal et al. 2022; Sammani et al. 2023; Davydko 2024; Guo et al. 2022; Guo et al. 2023

name: ADₚ / ICₚ
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: AD/IC variants scaled by the percentage of clean pixels to account for explanation sparsity. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

name: ADD
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: AD variant that measures the confidence drop after deleting the most influential region. Computation: Confidence score comparison.
review_studies: Gomez and Mouchère 2023; Arrighi et al. 2023

name: Pixel removal from original (Sujana & Augustine 2025)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Removes the most-important pixels from the original image at once. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

name: Superpixel removal from original (Rodrigues et al. 2024)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Removes the most-important superpixels from the original image at once. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

name: Concept removal from original (Kumar et al. 2021)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Removes the most-important concepts from the original image at once. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

name: Irrelevant-superpixel removal (Qian et al. 2025)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Removes superpixels deemed irrelevant by the explanation; the remaining image is expected to maintain or increase classifier confidence (aligns with the IC criterion). Computation: Confidence score comparison.

name: F-Fidelity
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Performs model retraining on explanation-agnostic masked images and explanation-guided pixel removal at evaluation to mitigate the OOD issue. Computation: Predicted label comparison.

name: FE (Faithfulness Estimate)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation between attribution scores and the prediction drop after removing pixels. Computation: PCC.
review_studies: Schulze-Weddige et al. 2025; Brzozowski et al. 2025

name: FE (SRCC variant)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: FE variant using Spearman rank correlation instead of Pearson correlation. Computation: SRCC.

name: DCᴄᴏᵣᵣ / ICᴄᴏᵣᵣ
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation-based variants of the Deletion and Insertion measures. Computation: PCC.
review_studies: Gomez et al. 2022; Gomez and Mouchère 2023; Davydko 2024

name: FC (Faithfulness Correlation)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation between the sum of attribution scores over perturbed feature subsets and the corresponding changes in model output. Computation: PCC.
review_studies: Mamalakis et al. 2025; Komorowski et al. 2023; Mir et al. 2025; Floreale et al. 2025; Aghaeipoor et al. 2025; Singh and Sharma 2025; Yoshikawa and Iwata 2024; Klotz et al. 2025; Chrabaszcz et al. 2025

name: Infidelity
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Mean distance between the sum of attribution scores over perturbed feature subsets and the corresponding changes in model output. Computation: Expected value.
review_studies: Pirie 2025; Agne et al. 2024; Saifullah et al. 2024

name: GEF (Generalized Explanation Faithfulness)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Geometry-aware correlation between model and explanation distortion vectors under model-parameter perturbations. Computation: SRCC.

name: EMBT (Evolving Model Backdoor Test)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation between model prediction and attribution assigned to a trigger region across a sequence of progressively backdoor-trained models. Computation: PCC.

name: PTT (Partial Trigger Test)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation between prediction scores and attribution assigned to a trigger region across inputs with increasing trigger coverage. Computation: PCC.

name: EMT (Evolving Model Test)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation between training loss and changes in the features identified as important across epoch checkpoints. Computation: PCC.

name: Concept-importance correlation (Li et al. 2021)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
description: Correlation between concept importance scores and the average prediction drop caused by suppressing each concept. Computation: PCC.

name: Fidelity (classification)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
subcategory: I.C - Agreement between black-box and explainer model predictions
description: Percentage of similar predictions between the black-box and explainer models; black-box predicted labels treated as ground truth. Computation: Accuracy score.
review_studies: Qi et al. 2021; Akpudo et al. 2024; Xie et al. 2023

name: Fidelity (regression)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
subcategory: I.C - Agreement between black-box and explainer model predictions
description: Relative error between the black-box and explainer model predictions. Computation: Relative error.

name: MAE agreement (Qi et al. 2021)
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
subcategory: I.C - Agreement between black-box and explainer model predictions
description: Mean absolute error between the black-box and explainer model predictions (regression). Computation: MAE.

name: Coherence
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
subcategory: I.C - Agreement between black-box and explainer model predictions
description: Strength of the linear relationship between the prediction sequences of the black-box and explainer models; applicable to classification and regression. Computation: Spectral density.
review_studies: Akpudo et al. 2024; Akpudo et al. 2025

name: Linear faithfulness score
category: I - Combination of attribution scores and black-box predictions
subcategory: I.D - Linear reconstruction of black-box predictions from concept scores
description: Logistic-regression classifier trained on concept activation scores to predict the ViT model's outputs. Computation: Accuracy score.

name: Max-Sensitivity
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: Maximum change in attribution maps under bounded input perturbations; lower values indicate more faithful (stable) explanations. Computation: Euclidean norm.
review_studies: Agne et al. 2024; Saifullah et al. 2024

name: Opposite-class patch substitution (Amorim et al. 2023)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: Salient regions are replaced with patches from opposite-class images; original and perturbed attribution maps are compared. Computation: Similarity/dissimilarity metrics (jAUC, bAUC, sAUC, NSS, IG, SIM, PCC; MAE, MSE, KL).
tags: II.A; Similarity/dissimilarity metrics (jAUC, bAUC, sAUC, NSS, IG, SIM, PCC; MAE, MSE, KL)

name: Thresholded-occlusion stability (Dakhli & Barhoumi 2024)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: Low-importance regions are removed using a thresholded attribution mask; original and occluded predictions and maps are compared. Computation: PCC.

name: Combined impact map (Vukadin et al. 2024a)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: Combines MoRF/LeRF masking and gradient-input maps to derive a combined impact map; alignment between attribution and impact map is evaluated. Computation: Element-wise map product and sum over map dimensions.
tags: II.A; Element-wise map product and sum over map dimensions

name: MPRT (Model Parameter Randomization Test)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: Attribution maps are recomputed after randomizing model weights and compared with the originals via similarity metrics. Computation: SRCC, SSIM, PCC of HOGs.
tags: II.B; SRCC, SSIM, PCC of HOGs
review_studies: Tatano et al. 2022; Barkan et al. 2023; Cheng et al. 2022

name: sMPRT (Smooth MPRT)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: MPRT refinement using denoised attribution maps averaged over Gaussian-perturbed input instances. Computation: SSIM.

name: eMPRT (Efficient MPRT)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: MPRT refinement using full model randomization and entropy-based comparison of attribution maps. Computation: Relative change in entropy.

name: CSC (Cosine Similarity Convergence)
category: II - Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
description: Different random initial relevance vectors are backpropagated through the network and the resulting relevance flows are compared. Computation: Cosine similarity.

name: DiFull
category: III - Spatial alignment against a model-guaranteed reference
description: GridPG variant in which each grid cell influences only the logit of its own class, so the reference region is guaranteed by the model architecture. Computation: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution.
tags: III; Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution
review_studies: Rao et al. 2022; Rao et al. 2024

name: CAM on 2D CNN + GAP
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: CAM applied to a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier, satisfying an exact additivity property. Computation: Analytical formula.

name: Grad-CAM on last conv + GAP
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: Grad-CAM applied to the last convolutional layer of a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier (reduces to CAM). Computation: Analytical formula.

name: HiResCAM on last conv + GAP
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: HiResCAM applied to the last convolutional layer of a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier. Computation: Analytical formula.

name: HiResCAM on last conv + Flatten
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: HiResCAM applied to the last convolutional layer of a 2D CNN with a Flatten layer before the classifier (only HiResCAM preserves additivity here). Computation: Analytical formula.

name: HiResCAM on AxialNet
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: HiResCAM applied to the last convolutional layer of the AxialNet architecture (3D volumes). Computation: Analytical formula.

name: AttLRP on Transformer
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: AttLRP algorithm applied to a Transformer architecture, preserving LRP's conservation principle. Computation: Analytical formula.

name: Concept-based decomposition (Zhou et al. 2018)
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: Concept-based decomposition applied to a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier. Computation: Analytical formula.

name: Prototype-based decomposition (Tan et al. 2024)
category: Analytical decomposition formulas
description: Prototype-based decomposition of the classification head of a part-prototype network, with completeness guarantees. Computation: Analytical formula.

name: LIME
category: Built-in faithfulness objective by utilizing the black-box model predictions
description: Explains individual predictions by generating perturbed superpixel samples around the input and fitting a simple interpretable surrogate model. Computation: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model.
tags: By-design: built-in; Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model
review_studies: Ribeiro et al. 2016; Laguna et al. 2023; Duan et al. 2023

name: UnRAvEL
category: Built-in faithfulness objective by utilizing the black-box model predictions
description: Builds on LIME using a Gaussian Process Regression surrogate and a Faithful Uncertainty Reduction (FUR) acquisition function. Computation: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model.
tags: By-design: built-in; Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model

name: FDbX
category: Built-in faithfulness objective by utilizing the black-box model predictions
description: Extends the LIME rationale to Siamese networks: explains similarity predictions by constructing a bipartite graph of superpixels and fitting a Ridge regression surrogate. Computation: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model.
tags: By-design: built-in; Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model

name: XNN (Qi et al. 2021)
category: Built-in faithfulness objective by utilizing the black-box model predictions
description: Explanation Neural Network that learns a low-dimensional explanation space able to mimic the black-box predictions. Computation: Dedicated loss term in the explainer model.
tags: By-design: built-in; Dedicated loss term in the explainer model

name: PACE
category: Built-in faithfulness objective by utilizing the black-box model predictions
description: Explainer model that learns concept relevance scores based on the prediction-probability drop caused by removing each concept. Computation: Dedicated loss term in the explainer model.
tags: By-design: built-in; Dedicated loss term in the explainer model

name: JMM (Joint Mask Method)
category: Built-in faithfulness objective by utilizing the black-box model predictions
description: Mask-based attribution method that jointly optimizes preservation and deletion masks. Computation: Optimization objective of the method.
tags: By-design: built-in; Optimization objective of the method

name: Pointing Game
category: Plausibility-adjacent methods
description: Checks whether the most important pixels fall inside the human-annotated image region. Computation: Number of hits over total pixels checked.
tags: Plausibility-adjacent; Number of hits over total pixels checked
review_studies: Sujana and Augustine 2025; Hakes et al. 2023

name: GridPG
category: Plausibility-adjacent methods
description: Evaluates whether attribution highlights the correct image cell in a grid of images. Computation: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution.
tags: Plausibility-adjacent; Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution
review_studies: Rao et al. 2022; Rao et al. 2024

name: DiPart
category: Plausibility-adjacent methods
description: Intermediate between GridPG and DiFull: partial disconnection of grid cells. Computation: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution.
tags: Plausibility-adjacent; Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution
review_studies: Rao et al. 2022; Rao et al. 2024

name: Attribute-Accuracy / Precision / Recall / F1
category: Plausibility-adjacent methods
description: Classification metrics extended to attribution maps; evaluate whether attribution highlights the target-class cells in a grid of images. Computation: TP, FP, TN, FN classification scores.
tags: Plausibility-adjacent; TP, FP, TN, FN classification scores
